name: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd
title: Shyam Metalics and Energy Ltd - 543299 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes up 22% YoY with EBITDA up 33%, but management is adding a fresh INR2,700 crore capex plan (stainless downstream, long wire mill) and guided ~30% FY27 growth; working-capital days were stretched via 130 payable days and 123 inventory days.

capex.quote: the Board has approved a fresh capex is INR2,700 crores for our next phase of growth

triggers.label: New capex INR2,700 crore approved
triggers.quote: the Board has approved a fresh capex is INR2,700 crores for our next phase of growth

triggers.label: Inventory days 99 → 123
triggers.quote: our inventory level in the last quarter was 99 days. Now we are taking the positioning of 123 days of inventory days

triggers.label: Payable days ~130
triggers.quote: Payable days is approximately is like 130 days, 130 days.

triggers.label: CR coil realisation +15% YoY
triggers.quote: CR coil, CR sheet realizations rose approximately 15% on a year-on basis, that is INR78,513 per tonne

triggers.label: FY27 growth ~30% indicated
triggers.quote: I think this year, we will be very comfortable with our growth close to 30% over this year.

guidance.quote: I think this year, we will be very comfortable with our growth close to 30% over this year.
I think the CRM EBITDA is going to be close to INR10,000 to INR11,000 per tonne this year
the aluminum EBITDA, I think, should remain between INR35,000 to INR40,000
This estimated investment is INR1,800 crores with a targeting commissioning date is March 2029.
